race.comment: THATS ARCHIES GIRL (12) is knocking on the door and is desperate to break through. Rattled home strongly again at the latest to grab third after turning a long way off them. Draws to get back again but should appreciate the extra 200m and with the benefit of the 3kg claim she should prove tough to hold out. RHETORIC (8) comes through the same Eagle Farm race, beaten just under two lengths after also making solid late inroads. Stays in the same grade and keeps Maloney. Right in play despite trying the distance for the first time. YES DONALD YES (5) got the job done here as favourite in style and has a two-from-two record at this trip. Fitter and can make it two on the bounce. SWIFT DUKE (4) adds depth after a fast-finishing fourth at Eagle Farm and a Beaudesert win before that. Sectionals suggest he will relish the added trip. MADAME CODY (16) returns and has been fitted with two trials. Has peaks that stack up and gets in light with the 3kg claimer engaged. Worth including.
